annotations.title: Report a wrong or missing answer

description:
Report an answer you believe is wrong or missing, so Fuentio checks it against the official source.
Use it when a result contradicts an official document you hold. Don't use it to ask questions: call the lookup tools.
Inputs: subject (entity ID, record ID such as 'FR-SIREN-441639465', or tool name), category (wrong_data, wrong_link, missing_data, wrong_status, other), message.
Returns: issue_id, status 'open'.
Limits: free; API key required; 20 reports per key per day.

message.description: What you expected and what you got.
examples: Shown active, BODACC published a liquidation.
